newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat slips in harvest trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat slips in harvest trade.

text.p: Argentine wheat slipped in good volume cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with plentiful harvest supply weighing on bids, traders said.

Spot prices paid to farmers for Bahia Blanca wheat retreated $1 to $133. Cash April maize shed $1 in good volume turnover, with the weekend's rain good for the crop and bearish for prices. May soybeans were unchanged at $249 in middling volume trade, with better, wetter weather in Brazil. March sunflower seed lost $2 to $215 in slow trade, with the climate good and oil prices weak.
